title: Number of Valid Clock Times
summary: Given a string of length 5 representing a time on a digital clock in 'hh:mm' format, where some digits are unknown and represented by '?', calculate the total number of valid clock times that can be formed by replacing each '?' with a digit from 0 to 9.
statement: Given a string of length 5 representing a time on a digital clock in 'hh:mm' format, where some digits are unknown and represented by '?', calculate the total number of valid clock times that can be formed by replacing each '?' with a digit from 0 to 9.
constraints: The pattern has HH:MM format and each question mark may be any digit.
A valid time has hours 00 through 23 and minutes 00 through 59.
Count all valid replacements matching every fixed character.
hints: There are only 24*60 valid concrete times.
Enumerate each hour and minute and format it with leading zeroes as HH:MM.
A candidate matches when every pattern position is ? or equals the candidate character.
Enumeration visits every valid clock time exactly once, so counting matches is complete and duplicate-free.
editorial: Enumeration visits every valid clock time exactly once, so counting matches is complete and duplicate-free.

tests.explanation: Only hours 05 and 15 match, giving two valid times.
Ten hour choices and ten minute-unit choices give one hundred valid times.
